API Function Header File Description Det _ Report - Error Det.h Service to report development errors. Ecu M _ - Check - Wakeup Ecu M.h This function can be called to check the given wakeup sources. It will pass the argument to the integrator function Ecu M_ Check Wakeup Ho ok. It can also be called by the ISR of a wakeup source to set up the PLL and check other wakeup sources that may be connected to the same interrupt.
